name: 7_region_new
description: Alternative calibration on byte-identical data to 7_region. Critical accumulation is roughly halved (5572 -> 2812) and, unlike the shipped set, this MFD has a real jam point (5536) because its cubic coefficient is negative. Supplied 2026-08-01 to probe for a UE/SO gap. WARNING: speed_unit_scale is an INFERENCE, not a stated value -- see README.md in this directory before trusting any absolute travel time.
source: UNKNOWN -- this parameter set appears nowhere in Qian et al. (2025). It is internally self-consistent (roots reproduce the stated 2812 and 5536 exactly) so it is a coherent calibration from a different source in a different convention. Provenance still to be confirmed with the dev who supplied it.
